info.title: Titan NF-e / NFC-e homologation print archive
info.description: Focus archive state is archived only after the encrypted customer-scoped row is actually persisted. An ignored write is a conflict/rollback and leaves archive_state=pending without discarding the authorized note; retry/query preserves its IDs and never implies another issuance. HTML/cupom rendering and PDF download tests do not approve physical printing or official Focus/SEFAZ acceptance.

get.summary: Impressão técnica do DANFE NF-e 55 / NFC-e 65 de homologação arquivado
get.description: Somente ambiente2 e emissão normal. Modelo65 requer largura58/80mm; modelo55 retrato requer210mm (A4). Seleção incompatível falha com409. NF-e55 tem folhas numeradas, cabeçalho repetido e código128 C/A para CNPJ numérico/alfanumérico. XML/protocolo selecionados do journal autenticado; não aceita XML, URL, certificado ou valores pelo cliente. Vendedor lê somente sua tentativa/aparelho; contabilidade autorizada lê a loja. Consulta mais recente pendente/negativa ou cancelamento iniciado bloqueiam cópia ativa. Sem rede, reenvio, nova assinatura ou efeito comercial. Configurar papel58/80mm ou A4 no driver; HTML não é PDF nem homologação oficial.

x-native-journal-encryption.scope: New native homologation issue/query/cancellation/invalidation request/result rows. No change to production enablement or fiscal semantics.
x-native-journal-encryption.key: Trusted customer process environment TITAN_FISCAL_JOURNAL_KEY_FILE: absolute path to a private regular 0600 32-byte file, provisioned with the existing titan-backup key-init command. No fallback, automatic generation, HTTP upload, key response or provider recovery. Missing/unreadable key refuses new journal writes before transmission.
x-native-journal-encryption.historical_keys: TITAN_FISCAL_JOURNAL_PREVIOUS_KEY_FILES is an optional JSON array of up to 16 customer-controlled private key paths. New writes use only the active key; historical keys permit reading older encrypted rows. Preserve old keys until backups are reencrypted and restoration is proven. This is NOT vault key rotation.
x-native-journal-encryption.record: Versioned AES-GCM envelope; tenant, store, journal kind, record ID and key ID authenticated as associated data. Original digests, IDs, no-repost barrier, current-session checks and immutable triggers retained. Ciphertext participates in existing business DB backup/restore.
x-native-journal-encryption.legacy: Existing immutable plaintext rows are neither deleted nor rewritten. Plaintext reads are refused by default; the customer may explicitly enable historical read compatibility via TITAN_FISCAL_JOURNAL_LEGACY_READ=true. This never permits new plaintext writes and retains all original digest/session/origin checks. Historical rows are NOT claimed to be encrypted; a customer-controlled migration remains pending.
x-native-journal-encryption.privacy: No key/path/XML in errors or logs. Authorized document downloads/export remain explicit. No new HTTP routes or fields. No real emission or official acceptance demonstrated.
